articles.summary: AWS Deadline Cloud now lets users who have access to specific queues, fleets, or jobs, rather than an entire farm, find the resources they can reach directly from the Deadline Cloud monitor. Deadline Cloud is a fully managed service that helps teams run compute-intensive workloads for visual effects, animation, product design, simulation, and gaming. Previously, a user with access to only one queue had to get the farm ID from an administrator before they could reach their work. With this launch, the Deadline Cloud monitor displays to users queues they have access to, the parent IDs needed to reach them, and their level of access, covering both direct and group-inherited permissions. Teams now can share a single monitor entry point (URL) across different permission levels without additional coordination. Resource discovery is available in all AWS Regions where Deadline Cloud is available. To learn more, visit the AWS Deadline Cloud user guide .
articles.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now helps users find their accessible resources in the Deadline Cloud monitor

articles.summary: Amazon SageMaker Studio now lets new customers sign up with their Google, GitHub, or Apple credentials and land inside a fully configured Studio environment - no traditional AWS account setup and no console navigation required. Previously, new customers who discovered a model on Hugging Face or an AWS product page had to complete a multi-step AWS account creation process, provide a credit card, navigate the AWS Console to find SageMaker AI, configure an environment, and set up IAM permissions before they could begin working. With earlier launches, we reduced environment setup to twenty seconds, pre-configured model customization permissions, and introduced deep links from Hugging Face and AWS product pages so customers could land directly inside Studio with a model pre-loaded. Now, with new sign-in options, customers complete a simplified sign-up using an existing identity, receive free credits as part of the AWS Free Tier with no credit card required in most cases, and arrive inside a ready-to-use SageMaker Studio environment where they can immediately fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy foundation models. Customers can invite team members by email, and collaborators sign in with their own email credentials to access the shared Studio environment, including shared models, notebooks, and endpoints without configuring IAM users or permissions. When a project grows beyond free credits, customers can upgrade to a paid plan and set a spend limit to stay within budget. Verified customers continue to receive default GPU access to G5, G6, G6e, and G4dn instances across endpoint deployments, training jobs, and notebooks without requesting quota increases. This feature is available in all AWS Commercial Regions where Amazon SageMaker Studio is supported. To get started, visit any supported model on Hugging Face and select "Customize and Deploy on SageMaker AI" or "Deploy on SageMaker AI," or click Get Started from the SageMaker Studio page. To learn more, see the AWS sign-up documentation and SageMaker Studio setup guide .
articles.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio simplifies getting started for new AI/ML builders with new sign-in options
